title: Looks good, not practical for me.
text:
Looks good, not practical for me.. This looks nice and the size is ok on my counter top in my dressing room near the sink.

My problem is, the holes on the side are small, holds two thin brushes maybe.
Lipstick falls out etc.
I have tubes of make up, and face creams , and tall
Thin bottles, there are hard to find among the other
Bottles, but if you get one up and out ,if you can find it, and it might touch
The other bottles they all Fall Over! It’s a mess for me.

I think this is good if you use this for large jars, as they do
Not fall over.
If you look at the picture of this it does not hold much but
Bigger bottles-jars ,perfumes .
If you want something that looks nice, But is not practical this is it.
